canDoYue: 你識帶身份同地址證明開戶，揀儲蓄戶口，講最低餘額同月費，等扣帳卡寄到，同埋登記網上理財。
canDoEn: Open an account with identity and proof of address, choose a savings account, hear the minimum balance and that there is no monthly fee, wait for the debit card by post, and register for online banking.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I want to open an account. Do you need my identity and proof of address?
dialogue.glossYue: 我想開戶口。你需唔需要我嘅身份同地址證明？
dialogue.say: I want to open an account. Do you need my identity and proof of address?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Yes. A recent proof of address can be a bank bill or a tax letter too.
dialogue.glossYue: 需要。最近嘅地址證明可以係銀行單或者稅單。
dialogue.say: Yes. A recent proof of address can be a bank bill or a tax letter too.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Should I choose a savings account or a current account for my daily pay?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。出糧用，我應該揀儲蓄戶口定往來戶口？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Should I choose a savings account or a current account for my daily pay?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: A savings account keeps some monthly interest, and the minimum balance is one thousand dollars flat.
dialogue.glossYue: 儲蓄戶口有少少月息，最低餘額係一千蚊正。
dialogue.say: A savings account keeps some monthly interest, and the minimum balance is one thousand dollars flat.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Is there any monthly fee if my balance stays quite high through each whole month?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果每個月餘額都維持喺高位，有冇月費？
dialogue.say: Is there any monthly fee if my balance stays quite high through each whole month?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: No monthly fee at all. Your new debit card will arrive by post in five days.
dialogue.glossYue: 完全冇月費。你張新扣帳卡五日內會寄到。
dialogue.say: No monthly fee at all. Your new debit card will arrive by post in five days.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I register for online banking before that debit card arrives by post next week?
dialogue.glossYue: 扣帳卡下星期寄到之前，我可唔可以登記網上理財？
dialogue.say: Can I register for online banking before that debit card arrives by post next week?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Yes. Online banking opens tomorrow morning, once we finish checking all of your signed bank paperwork.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。網上理財聽朝開通，等我哋核完你簽好嘅文件。
dialogue.say: Yes. Online banking opens tomorrow morning, once we finish checking all of your signed bank paperwork.
